reason: I already do my big shop once a week in Jbeil and I watch every dollar. I'd be handing my list to strangers and just trusting them about what they paid at the till.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? A $2 fee on top of that adds up when money is this tight.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual supermarket receipt with every bag, from someone in my village I know and trust, and a free first bag to try.
